'''Icetrompers''' were giant four-legged herd beasts mainly found on the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], although they were also present on the planet [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]. They were occasionally preyed on by [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]], but their main predators were [[Human/Legends|Human]] big-game hunters.

==Biology==
[[File:Ice_tromper.png|thumb|left|190px|An Icetromper on Hoth]]
Icetrompers had an immensely thick pelt, sometimes as thick as a foot. The pelt was a prized trophy for any game hunter and used for blankets, thick clothing, and bedding. They had an equally thick layer of blubber (which was harvested for oil) to protect them from [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth's]] vicious blizzards. They had a huge set of horns that grew at a rate of around one curl per year. These were also a prize to any big-game hunter, and were much sought after. A breed that possessed red fur and was intended to be ridden could be won by patrons of the [[Star Cluster Casino]] or [[Club Vertica Casino]].<ref name="Star Cluster Casino">{{TORcite|type=location|Star Cluster Casino|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref><ref name="Club Vertica Casino">{{TORcite|type=location|Club Vertica Casino|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

==Behavior==
Icetromper [[Gender/Legends|males]] won mates by locking horns and shoving until one gave up. Icetrompers generally had one to two calves a year.
